capabilities.justification: Opens each agent key file under the owner-only policy, without reading it, to pass the descriptor to that agent's broker.

capabilities.target: the directories holding secrets: each key file's, and the vault's
capabilities.justification: Checks each is an owner-only directory before every broker launch (D18S P2.6d-3); a stat through a descriptor, no read.
Starts one broker per agent by executing the verified descriptor (D18S S-K1), never by path, confined by chief-of-staff-linux-sandbox under a plan with no capabilities (P2.6d-3).

justification: Launches and relays to per-agent brokers (D18S P2.6d), holding no channel key itself.
